title: Synth instrument document
description: One instrument for the sculptor synth, written for humans and LLMs. Units are musical: times in seconds, LFO rates in Hz, pitches in semitones, amounts 0..1. Paste into a zone with the zone right-click menu's 'Paste from Clipboard'. Copy an existing zone with 'Copy to Clipboard' to see a real document. A document is rejected whole (nothing changes) when a field is unknown or out of range, or when a required field is missing. Omitted optional fields have working defaults; nested objects must provide their own required fields. The bank's channel and master effect chains and free-standing parameters are outside this format on purpose: a document covers the instrument only.

format.description: Required document type and version identifier. The v1 decoder refuses any other value.

note_skew_semitones.description: Random pitch skew drawn once per note.

layer_skew_semitones.description: Random pitch skew drawn per oscillator layer.

release_seconds.description: Sustain decay length: once a layer's volume envelope enters its sustain span, the whole volume decays exponentially toward silence over this many seconds, through the release as well.  0 keeps the legacy hold/loop behavior.

graph_layout.description: Optional portable positions and sizes of nodes derived from this instrument; no effects, wiring or missing-sum state.  Canonical 0 is input, 1 is sum, 2+n is oscillator layer n, which must exist.  Generator locators use layer and fixed numeric ModTarget; descriptor aliases resolve after the whole document parses and may have only one saved record.  Unresolved or duplicate resolved nodes are refused.  All numbers must be finite; sizes are nonnegative.  Newly encoded documents always include this array.

layers.description: Oscillator layers mixed together in one instrument voice. The editor supports up to 7; each Add Oscillator action adds one layer.

wave.description: Waveform names. A sawtooth at duty 0.5 is a triangle; a pulse at duty 0.5 is a square; set the target block 'duty_a' or 'duty_b' to place the duty.  Pad uses duty as the harmonic wander depth (0 = locked, 1 = deepest). String is a plucked string, accepted as wave_a only (wave_b refuses it).

mod_target.description: Modulated quantities. Units: volume, panning (0.5 = center), duty_a/duty_b, osc_mix and fm_index (1.0 = full depth) are 0..1; pitch is -24..24 semitones; fir_pitch_spread depends on the layer fir_type: bandpass = spread in semitones 0..36 around the note pitch, one band of up to four (fir_bands); lowpass and highpass = fixed cutoff in Hz 0..22050 with no key tracking, 0 = the edge-off bypassed state; a bandpass bypasses only while every band's spread is zero, so a zero band 0 spread with a positive higher-band spread still filters; fm_ratio is the ratio, slider-bounded 0.125..8 (0 stays bank-legal as the legacy unset carrier value). Only 'volume' defaults to 1.0 and 'panning' to 0.5, fm_ratio inherits the layer's legacy mod_ratio when its block is absent, and every other base defaults to 0. pad_tone_a/pad_tone_b is the per-oscillator pad spectral tilt in -1..+1: the harmonic exponent is 1 + value (0 = saw-like 1/n spectrum, +1 = mellow 1/n^2, -1 = flat/brightest), inert for non-pad waves. string_damping/string_release_damping are 0..1 (0 = natural decay) and inert for non-string waves. fir_slope is the FIR window slope as an integer percent 1..100; an unrouted layer carries it in the layer's fir_slope scalar, a routed one in the target block's base.

mod_source.description: MIDI modulation sources. velocity is per-note; aftertouch is polyphonic; pressure_combine is the max of per-note aftertouch and channel pressure.

source_op.description: How a value combines onto its target: added or multiplied.

layer.description: One oscillator. The shared routing (base, sources) may be set by the first layer that supplies base or sources for a target (a layer with only generators does not claim it); every layer has its own envelope and LFO generators.

wave_a.description: Required. The primary oscillator; for fm the carrier, for sync the master.

wave_b.description: The second oscillator; for fm the modulator, for sync the slave, for ring_mod the carrier. Default: none.

mode.description: blend mixes both waves by osc_mix; fm frequency-modulates wave_a with wave_b; sync hard-syncs wave_b to wave_a; ring_mod multiplies wave_a by wave_b evaluated at mod_ratio * wave_a's phase, with osc_mix crossfading the dry wave_a to the product.

mod_ratio.description: The FM ratio (fm) or hard-sync cycle ratio (sync); 0 is a legal bank value, any nonzero value is 0.125..8; ignored by blend. For ring_mod it is the carrier ratio. The static value mirrors the fm_ratio target base for compatibility.

octave_offset.description: Whole-octave pitch shift; 12 * octave_offset semitones are added to the oscillator pitch.

oneOf.description: FIR window slope percent; 100 is the sharpest response (the full 1025-tap window), lower values widen the transition band. The window span grows exponentially with the percent: 11 taps at 1, 1025 taps at 100. Only present while the layer's fir_slope target is unrouted; a routed layer states the target block instead and the scalar re-decodes to the default 100.

fir_slope.description: FIR window slope: the integer percent scalar when the layer's fir_slope target is unrouted, or that target's block (its base is the integer percent 1..100, see mod_target) when it is routed. The two forms never appear together in one layer object.

fir_bands.description: Active bandpass band count; absent decodes as the legacy single band. Bands 1..3 state their four parameters as fir_bandN_offset/spread/gain/slope target blocks; band 0 reuses fir_pitch_spread and fir_slope and adds fir_band0_offset/fir_band0_gain. A band whose block is absent decodes its defaults (offset 0, spread 0, gain 1, slope 100 for bands 1..3); a present block with an omitted base decodes 0, so an explicitly saved gain-0 band stays inactive instead of reloading as the 1.0 default.

fir_type.description: Oscillator filter type. bandpass uses fir_pitch_spread as a spread in semitones (0..36) around the note pitch; lowpass and highpass use it as a fixed cutoff in Hz (0..22050); off disables the filter.

string_pick.description: Plucked-string pick position, 0 = no comb (default), up to 1; used by wave_a string only.

string_brightness.description: Plucked-string pluck brightness; 1 = unfiltered excitation burst (default), lower values low-pass the burst for a warmer pluck; used by wave_a string only.

string_dispersion.description: Plucked-string dispersion (stiff-string inharmonicity, strongest on low notes); 0 = off (default), up to 1; used by wave_a string only.

string_dispersion_sections.description: Plucked-string dispersion allpass section count, 1 to 6 (default 4); ignored while string_dispersion is 0; used by wave_a string only.

routing.description: Bank-style routing alias: keyed by mod_target name, each value a bank routing block. Accepted so a routing block can share a layer with the fir_slope scalar key; documents written by the encoder never include it.

bank_routing_block.description: The saved-bank spelling of one target's routing: base_value in the target's units (for fir_slope, an integer percent 1..100) and up to two MIDI inputs.

target_block.description: One modulated quantity: a shared base value plus MIDI sources, with this layer's envelope and LFO generators on top.

base.description: The value in the target's units (see mod_target). Defaults: volume 1.0, panning 0.5, fm_ratio 1.0, everything else 0. The fm_ratio default applies on layer 0, whose targets are pre-seeded to these defaults, and on any layer whose fm_ratio block states sources without base; a later-layer fm_ratio block that states neither base nor sources keeps the zeroed binding; a wholly absent fm_ratio block instead inherits the layer's legacy mod_ratio scalar (see mod_target).

sources.description: MIDI inputs combined onto the base value.

scale.description: How much of the source applies; negative inverts.

envelope.description: The envelope this layer plays into the target. Point levels are the envelope's output values in the target's units, so a volume envelope sweeps 0..1 and a pitch envelope sweeps semitones.

time_seconds.description: When the point is reached. Points quantize to ~5.8 ms ticks; a leading run of time 0 is allowed (the unplaced-point layout) and every later point must land on a later tick. The maximum is ~380 s.

level.description: The value reached, in the target's units. Generator levels are free finite values - the editor's envelope min/max slots are unbounded - so unlike the base they are not restricted to the slider range. Levels quantize to 16-bit steps; a spread level <= 0 bypasses the oscillator's filter at that point (generator levels stay free finite values, negatives included, clamped at use).

sustain_start.description: First point of the sustain loop; defaults to the last point (hold the end value until release).

sustain_end.description: Last point of the sustain loop; must not precede sustain_start; defaults to the last point.

ping_pong.description: Multi-point sustain spans bounce between their ends instead of looping back to the span start; requires more than one point in the span.  0 keeps the legacy loop.

quick_release.description: Note-off jumps forward to the first release-tail point at or below the current level; the final point is the fallback.  0 plays through the sustain span to the end.

depth.description: Multiplier on this envelope's contribution into its target. Lets several targets reuse one envelope shape at different amounts. 0 silences the contribution.

wave.description: Required. The pool only holds sine and sawtooth LFOs; place the duty with this LFO's own 'duty' field.

frequency_hz.description: Required. Cycles per second; the period must land between 1 ms and 65.535 s.

min_level.description: The LFO's low output, in the target's units; free finite values, not restricted to the base's slider range. Defaults to the target's minimum.

max_level.description: The LFO's high output, in the target's units; free finite values, not restricted to the base's slider range. Defaults to the target's maximum.

op.description: How the LFO combines onto the target.

depth.description: How much of the LFO applies; negative inverts.

depth_source.description: A MIDI source scaling the depth.

rate_source.description: A MIDI source scaling the rate.

rate_scale_ms.description: Milliseconds of period the rate source adds per unit.
